data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 6104 opened 2020 with gross claims outstanding of $242.3m. During the year there was a small prior-year favourable movement (an over-provision) of $1.682m (0.7% of opening reserves), reflecting favourable prior-year claims development. Reserves remain materially influenced by prior natural catastrophe losses (notably 2018 hurricanes Michael/Florence, typhoons Jebi/Trami and Northern California wildfires, and 2019 events including Dorian, Faxai and Hagibis and California wildfires) and by COVID-19 exposure arising from reinsurance of business interruption, for which the Syndicate holds explicit reserves.

data.data_quality_notes: All monetary amounts are reported in the syndicate's functional currency (USD). Field names in the template reference GBP but values are provided in USD (native currency of the accounts). Prior-year movement is taken from the Technical Provisions note (line: 'Over-provision in respect of prior claims and claim adjustment expenses 1,682') and interpreted as a release (hence negative sign). Exact_reserve_text is taken from the table row since no standalone narrative sentence quantifying gross prior-year movement was present. Claims development triangle used is the gross table in the underwriting year notes. Some named-event amounts are reported as gross reserves in the report; net-to-syndicate amounts are not always separately specified and are therefore null where not explicitly stated.
